ayahs.translation: Say: “I seek refuge with the Lord of the rising day;
from the evil of all that He created;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ اِذَا وَقَبَۙ
ayahs.translation: from the evil of night's darkness when it spreads around;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ النَّفّٰثٰتِ فِی الْعُقَدِۙ
ayahs.translation: from the evil of the women who blow on knots;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ اِذَا حَسَدَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and from the evil of the envier when he envies.”
